classification_rule: Only diagnostics containing a literal '[CPLUS-' token count as tagged C+ enforcement. REJECT = check exits nonzero with a [CPLUS- token naming the invalid operation; ACCEPT = check exits 0; PARTIAL = nonzero without a [CPLUS- token. Runtime aborts (UBSan, SIGSEGV) and untagged lowering/type errors are never enforcement.
